title: 'We're the aquarium'

tellings.quote: These guys said, "Well, you've heard of the Aviary." And that had been on that TV show, of course. And um they said, "Well, we're the aquarium."

plain: In 1996, at the Los Angeles offices of Dark Skies, a TV drama about a government UFO cover-up, some visitors told the show's makers that they belonged to a group called "the aquarium." The TV writer and producer Bryce Zabel, who was there, tells Michels the men, whom he calls JC and the captain, said: "Well, you've heard of the Aviary," a circle of insiders interested in UFOs that had already turned up on a TV show, "well, we're the aquarium." If true, it would mean a second hidden group of insiders was reaching out to Hollywood.
